notizie.titolo: The EBA outlines next steps on supervisory reporting simplification and extends implementation timelines following consultation feedback on the ITS
notizie.descrizione: The European Banking Authority (EBA) today outlines the way forward for the finalisation of proposals to simplify EU supervisory reporting, following extensive dialogue with the banking industry and feedback received during the public consultation. The package that is currently being finalised will introduce additional simplification measures, greater proportionality and extended implementation timelines, reducing reporting costs while preserving the information necessary for effective supervision. The final report on the draft Implementing Technical Standards (ITS) on supervisory reporting will be published by the EBA in December 2026.

notizie.feed: EBA - news
notizie.titolo: The EBA publishes revised Guidelines on internal governance, delivering greater proportionality and simplification for banks
notizie.descrizione: The European Banking Authority (EBA) today published its revised Guidelines on internal governance under the Capital Requirements Directive (CRD). The revised Guidelines reflect the changes introduced by CRD VI and form part of the EBA’s broader commitment to simplify the regulatory framework, strengthen proportionality and reduce unnecessary compliance burdens, while safeguarding sound and robust governance across the EU banking sector.

notizie.feed: EBA - news
notizie.titolo: The EBA advises on targeted simplifications to Taxonomy disclosures
notizie.descrizione: The European Banking Authority (EBA) has published its response to the European Commission’s Call for Technical Advice on certain key performance indicators (KPIs) and other aspects of the Disclosures Delegated Act under Article 8 of the Taxonomy Regulation. The EBA advises on targeted changes to streamline disclosure requirements, reduce complexity and enhance the usability of information disclosed by credit institutions and investment firms.

notizie.feed: EBA - news
notizie.titolo: ​The EBA appoints Kristīne Černaja-Mežmale as its new Vice-Chair
notizie.descrizione: ​The Board of Supervisors of the European Banking Authority (EBA) has elected Kristīne Černaja-Mežmale as its Vice-Chair for a duration of two and a half years. Ms Černaja-Mežmale will take up her new role on 1 November 2026 when the current EBA Vice-Chair, Helmut Ettl starts his new role as Executive Director of the International Monetary Fund (IMF).

notizie.feed: EBA - news
notizie.titolo: The ​EBA extends some consultation deadlines due to website maintenance​
notizie.descrizione: On 21 October 2026, CERT-EU, the cybersecurity service for the EU institutions, bodies and agencies, alerted organisations to two critical security flaws in software used to run many websites, including that of the European Banking Authority (EBA). As a precaution, the EBA took its website offline on Wednesday 21 October 2026 at 13:00 CEST while the necessary security updates were applied. The website was restored on Thursday 22 October 2026 at 14:00 CEST.

notizie.feed: EBA - news
notizie.titolo: ​The EBA classifies USDC as the first significant e-money token in the European Union
notizie.descrizione: ​The European Banking Authority (EBA) has classified USDC, issued by Circle Internet Financial Europe SAS, as a significant e-money token (EMT) under the Markets in Crypto Assets Regulation (MiCA), following its assessment of the criteria set out in the Regulation. There are currently 45 EMTs in the European Union, which have been notified under MiCA, and USDC is the first one to be classified as being significant.

notizie.feed: EBA - news
notizie.titolo: European Supervisory Authorities set priorities for 2027
notizie.descrizione: The Joint Committee of the European Supervisory Authorities (EBA, EIOPA and ESMA – the ESAs) published today its Annual Work Programme for 2027, setting out its priorities for addressing cross-sectoral risks and strengthening coordination across the European Union's financial sector.

notizie.feed: EBA - news
notizie.titolo: ​The EBA releases the final technical package for release 4.4 of its reporting and Pillar 3 disclosure framework
notizie.descrizione: ​The European Banking Authority (EBA) today released the final technical package for version 4.4 of its reporting and disclosure framework, covering IFRS 18 reporting, Pillar 3 ESG disclosures and other technical amendments.

notizie.feed: EBA - news
notizie.titolo: The EBA publishes Final Report on draft amendments to technical standards on prudential requirements for central securities depositories
notizie.descrizione: The European Banking Authority (EBA) today published a report proposing draft amendments to the Regulatory Technical Standards (RTS) on certain prudential requirements for central securities depositories (CSDs) and designated credit institutions offering ‘banking-type ancillary services’. This mostly responds to changes introduced by the Central Securities Depositories Regulation (CSDR) “Refit”, notably those allowing banking CSDs to provide banking-type ancillary services to other CSDs.

notizie.feed: EBA - news
notizie.titolo: EBA CRR3/CRD6 dashboard shows banks maintain capital levels well above minimum requirements under the fully loaded Basel III framework
notizie.descrizione: The European Banking Authority (EBA) today published its CRR3/CRD6 dashboard as of Q2 2026 for 129 banks at the highest level of consolidation across the EU/EEA. EU/EEA banks maintain capital levels well above minimum requirements under the fully loaded CRR3 framework, with an average Common Equity Tier 1 (CET1) ratio projected at 15.1%, despite an increased impact of the output floor compared with previous editions.
